artistic talent: Even as a child, Emma showed great artistic talent, drawing beautiful pictures of animals and flowers.
艾瑪從小就展現出極高的藝術天分，畫出美麗的動物和花朵圖畫。
artistic freedom: The director demanded full artistic freedom, so the company allowed him to make the movie his own way.
導演要求完全的藝術創作自由，所以公司允許他用自己的方式拍電影。
the artistic director: The artistic director of the dance company decides which shows will be performed each season.
這個舞團的藝術總監決定每一季要演出哪些節目。
be ashamed of oneself: You should be ashamed of yourself for lying to your parents about where you went last night.
你騙父母昨晚去了哪裡，應該為自己感到羞愧。
be ashamed to admit: I am ashamed to admit that I have never read a whole English novel, even though I study English every day.
我羞於承認，雖然我每天讀英文，卻從來沒有讀完一整本英文小說。
feel deeply ashamed: After shouting at his little sister for no reason, Tom felt deeply ashamed and said sorry to her.
無緣無故對妹妹大吼之後，湯姆深感羞愧，並向她道歉。
an associate professor: Dr. Lin is an associate professor at the university and hopes to become a full professor in a few years.
林博士是這所大學的副教授，希望幾年後能升為正教授。
an associate member: As an associate member of the club, you can use the pool, but you cannot vote at meetings.
身為俱樂部的準會員，你可以使用游泳池，但不能在會議中投票。
a business associate: My father had dinner with a business associate from Japan to discuss a new trade deal.
我爸爸和一位來自日本的生意夥伴共進晚餐，討論一項新的貿易協議。
an athletic build: Leo has an athletic build with strong arms and wide shoulders, so people often think he plays basketball.
里歐有運動員般的體格，手臂強壯、肩膀寬闊，所以大家常以為他打籃球。
athletic ability: Her athletic ability helped her win three gold medals in running and jumping on the school sports day.
她的運動能力幫助她在校運會的跑步和跳遠項目中贏得三面金牌。
the athletic department: The athletic department of our school bought new basketballs and running shoes for the sports teams.
我們學校的體育組為運動校隊買了新的籃球和跑鞋。
the atomic bomb: The atomic bomb dropped on Hiroshima in 1945 killed many thousands of people and helped end the war.
1945年投在廣島的原子彈造成數萬人死亡，並促使戰爭結束。
atomic energy: Some people support atomic energy because it causes less air pollution, while others fear nuclear accidents.
有些人支持原子能，因為它造成的空氣污染較少，而另一些人則害怕核子事故。
at the atomic level: Scientists study materials at the atomic level to understand how the tiny particles inside them behave.
科學家在原子層面研究材料，以了解其中微小粒子的運作方式。
an attractive offer: The company made her an attractive offer with a high salary and free housing, so she accepted the job.
公司給了她一個誘人的提議，包括高薪和免費住宿，所以她接受了這份工作。
an attractive proposition: For students who want to study abroad, a free English course is an attractive proposition that few would refuse.
對想出國留學的學生來說，免費英文課程是很少人會拒絕的有吸引力的提案。
be attractive to investors: To be attractive to investors, the new company needs a good business plan and a strong team.
為了對投資者有吸引力，這家新公司需要好的營運計畫和堅強的團隊。
audio equipment: The school bought new audio equipment, including speakers and microphones, for the music festival.
學校為音樂節購買了新的音響設備，包括喇叭和麥克風。
an audio file: The teacher sent us an audio file of the listening test so we could practice at home with our phones.
老師寄給我們聽力測驗的音訊檔，讓我們可以在家用手機練習。
audio-visual aids: Teachers often use audio-visual aids such as videos and songs to make English lessons more fun.
老師們常使用影片和歌曲等視聽教具，讓英文課更有趣。
authentic Italian food: This small restaurant serves authentic Italian food, made by a chef who came from Rome ten years ago.
這家小餐廳供應道地的義大利料理，由一位十年前從羅馬來的廚師烹調。
an authentic signature: Experts checked the painting and confirmed that it had an authentic signature of the famous artist, not a fake one.
專家檢查這幅畫，確認上面是那位知名畫家的真跡簽名，而不是偽造的。
an authentic account: The old soldier's book gives an authentic account of life during the war, based on his own experience.
這位老兵的書根據他的親身經歷，提供了戰爭期間生活的真實可信的敘述。
an automatic response: Saying "thank you" has become an automatic response for him; he does it without even thinking.
說「謝謝」對他來說已成為不由自主的反應，他連想都不用想就會說。
automatic promotion: In this school, students get automatic promotion to the next grade, even if their test scores are low.
在這所學校，即使考試成績很低，學生也會自動升級到下一個年級。
an automatic right to…: Being born into a rich family does not give you an automatic right to success; you still need to work hard.
出生在富裕家庭並不代表你理所當然享有成功的權利，你仍然需要努力。
be automatic for members: Discounts are automatic for members, so you do not need to show a coupon when you pay at the counter.
折扣是會員自動享有的，所以你在櫃台結帳時不需要出示優惠券。
